name: 02-valid-every-condition
pack_def:
pack x
version 0.1.0
default keep
forget_ms 1000
rule r drop
when circle lat=-90 lon=180 radius_m=0
when not polygon vertices=0,0;0,1;1,1
when near reference=own/OS1 radius_m=1.5 max_age_ms=0
when env in=A,S
when affiliation in=h
when source in=a
when uid in=b
when key name=k eq=x
when key name=k in=x,y
when key name=k min=-1
when key name=k max=1
when key name=k min=1 max=1
when has name=k
when speed min=0
when altitude min=-10.5 max=100
when interval min_ms=1
when order
